ruling.RULING-6: A lane binding is only real if the lane can RUN on it, and only the run proves it. After the reboot the Codex toolchain pin named a binary the in-place upgrade had removed, so all three lanes were fail-closed dead: the independent acceptance officer could not run, and no amount of config inspection would have said so. The repair had to move two surfaces together (the live declaration and the registry's expected values) because the drift gate compares them, and it had to be proved by a live probe with a nonce and a usage receipt, not by a green config test. The same round also produced the mirror lesson for prose: the pool's per-lane selection_note was a hand-written declaration of a machine-checked field, it had gone stale, and no automated gate had flagged it because prose is not a machine-checked field. Generated declarations beat maintained ones.
